objective: Mine one daily ETF factor on A-share on-shore ETFs using the WorldQuant 5-agent workflow. Mechanism must be orthogonal to the prior 20260423 reversal and weekly-TQPB sessions.

mechanism_candidates.name: amount_based_stealth_accumulation_pvo
mechanism_candidates.why: Institutional ETF buying leaves a volume footprint before a price footprint. High-amount / low-price-impact days identify patient one-sided flow that predicts 5-20d returns. Fully orthogonal to the prior reversal (price-only) and weekly-TQPB (volume-as-filter) sessions.
supporting_evidence: Llorente-Michaely-Saar-Wang (2002) RFS 15:1005-1047 — informed vs liquidity volume decomposition
Kaniel-Saar-Titman (2008) JFE 63:273-310 — persistent one-sided flow predicts returns
logs/20260423_a_share_etf_weekly_tqpb_v1 r1_breakout_vol_conf: weekly LS Sharpe +0.45 with volume as filter
caveats: daily horizon is cost-sensitive (Pitfall 10) — use weekly rebalance and explicit cost sensitivity
log(amount) = log(close) + log(volume) — use z-scored per-symbol to remove price-level effect
4 of 34 ETFs have thin Yahoo history (131 bars) and will be excluded from cross-section until 60d accumulates
check correlation vs 20d momentum and 60d log(amount) level — if >0.5, factor is a vehicle for a known premium (Pitfall 9)
look-ahead risk must be directly audited via future_perturbation_test
